_comment: Pins the second rule source: Lenovo's own parallel-window corpus, extracted from the
factory ZUI image this port was built from. Changing any digest here means a different
firmware, not a conversion change -- re-review before moving one.
The importer verifies zui_corpus.sha256 and local_additions.sha256 before merging.

provenance.reason: First-party rules written by this device's OEM for this device, in the exact schema this port already parses.

local_additions.reason: The declaration of what is taken from the ZUI corpus and what is authored here. Digest-pinned so a re-import cannot silently change the local layer either.

policy: Only packages absent from the 3.01.48 conversion are taken from the ZUI corpus. Where both
sources have a package, 3.01.48 wins, because that is the corpus the golden counts pin and
mixing two vendors' presentation choices per package would be unauditable.
Hand-authored rows in local_additions.json override both, and each one must carry the exact
APK version, versionCode and SHA-256 it was verified against.
